==English== ===Alternative forms=== * {{alt|en|acrost||nonstandard|or|dialectal}} ===Etymology=== {{etymon|en|:inh|enm:acros|tree=1}} From {{inh|en|enm|acros}}, from early {{inh|en|enm|a-croiz}}, {{m|enm|a-creoyz}}, from {{der|en|xno|an||in, on}} + {{m|fro|croiz||in the form of a cross}}. More at {{m|en|cross}}. {{surf|+pre|en|a|cross}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/əˈkɹɒs/|a=RP,NZ}}, {{enPR|ə-krŏs'''′'''}} * {{IPA|en|/əˈkɹɔs/|a=SSB,AU}} * {{a|en|GA}} ** {{IPA|en|/əˈkɹɔs/|a=non-cot-caught}}, {{enPR|ə-krôs'''′'''}} ** {{IPA|en|/əˈkɹɑs/|a=cot-caught}}, {{enPR|ə-krŏs'''′'''}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-across.ogg|a=US}} ** {{IPA|en|/əˈkɹɔst/|/əˈkɹɑst/|a=proscribed}} * {{IPA|en|/əˈkɹɒs/|a=CA}} * {{IPA|en|/əˈkɾɔs/|a=Scotland}} * {{hyph|en|a|cross}} * {{rhymes|en|ɒs|s=2}} ===Preposition=== {{wikidata lexeme|L3233}} {{en-head|prep}} # [[to|To]], [[toward]]{{,}} or [[from]] the [[far]] side of (something that lies between two points of interest). #: {{ux|en|We rowed '''across''' the river.}} #: {{ux|en|Fortunately, there was a bridge '''across''' the river.}} #: {{ux|en|He came '''across''' the street to meet me.}} # On the [[opposite]] side of (something that lies between two points of interest). #: {{ux|en|That store is '''across''' the street.}} # {{lb|en|Southern US|AAVE}} across from: on the opposite side, relative to something that lies between, from (a point of interest). #*: And make sure you're parked '''across''' the mall in the outside lot. {{...}} Last time I was there, I parked in a parking structure and paid an arm and a leg for it. #* {{quote-book|en|year=1995|author=w:Ronald Kessler|title=Inside the White House|year_published=1996|pageurl=http://books.google.com/books?id=lJz-yIZNE2sC&pg=PA243&dq=across|page=243|isbn=0671879197 |passage=On another occasion, Clinton asked [[w:Troopergate (Bill Clinton)|Patterson]] to drive him to Chelsea's school, Booker Elementary, where Clinton met the department store clerk and climbed into her car.
"I parked '''across''' the entrance and stood outside the car looking around, about 120 feet from where they were parked in a lot that was pretty well lit," Patterson recalled. "{{...}}They stayed in the car for thirty to forty minutes."}} # From one [[side]] to the [[other]] within (a space being traversed). #: {{ux|en|The meteor streaked '''across''' the sky.}} #: {{ux|en|He walked '''across''' the room.}} #: {{ux|en|Could you slide that '''across''' the table to me, please?}} #* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=8|passage=I corralled the judge, and we started off '''across''' the fields, in no very mild state of fear of that gentleman's wife, whose vigilance was seldom relaxed. With that she was '''across''' the room and out the door.}} # [[span|Spanning]]. #: {{ux|en|This poetry speaks '''across''' the centuries.}} # [[throughout|Throughout]]. #: {{ux|en|All '''across''' the country, voters were communicating their representatives.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|year=2012|month=March-April|author=Anna Lena Phillips|volume=100|issue=2|page=172 |magazine=w:American Scientist |title=[http://www.americanscientist.org/bookshelf/pub/sneaky-silk-moths Sneaky Silk Moths] |passage=Last spring, the periodical cicadas emerged '''across''' eastern North America. Their vast numbers and short above-ground life spans inspired awe and irritation in humans—and made for good meals for birds and small mammals.}} #* {{quote-journal|en|date=2013-06-21|author=[http://guardian.co.uk/profile/chico-harlan/ Chico Harlan] |volume=189|issue=2|page=30|magazine=w:The Guardian Weekly |title=[http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2013/jun/18/japan-solar-energy-fukushima-nuclear-renewable-abe Japan pockets the subsidy …] |passage='''Across''' Japan, technology companies and private investors are racing to install devices that until recently they had little interest in: solar panels.
